description: Configuration and admin. Actions: "session" → set agent identity (call this first), "pipeline" → get/set pipeline stages and gate config for a project, "cleanup" → purge old completed tasks, "rules" → generate IDE rule files (.mdc or CLAUDE.md).

format.description: Output format for rules: mdc (Cursor) or claude_md (Claude Code)

gate_config.description: Stage-gate enforcement config (pipeline only). Example: { "require_comment": true, "require_artifact": false, "exempt_stages": ["backlog"] }

require_approval.description: Require an approved approval before advancing from this stage

require_artifacts.description: Named artifacts that must exist at the stage before advancing

require_comment.description: Require at least one comment before advancing from this stage

require_min_artifacts.description: Minimum number of artifacts required at the stage

gates.description: Per-stage gate rules. Keys are stage names, values are StageGate objects with: require_artifacts (string[]), require_min_artifacts (number), require_comment (boolean), require_approval (boolean)

require_artifact.description: Require at least one artifact at current stage before advancing (default: false)

require_comment.description: Require at least one comment before advancing (default: false)

project.description: Project name (pipeline: scope, rules: project-specific rules)

stages.description: Stage names in order (pipeline set mode)

timeout_minutes.description: Heartbeat timeout in minutes for stale agent detection (cleanup only, default: 30)

name: task_config
